prompt: Propose a Phase II clinical trial in women of childbearing potential with primary biliary cholangitis at maximum treatment duration of 30 days. Enumerate the nonclinical studies required to support this trial per ICH M3(R2). Cite the applicable ICH guideline for each study (ICH M3(R2) Table 1, ICH S2(R1), ICH S7A, ICH S7B, ICH S5(R3), ICH S1A as applicable).
chosen:
Per ICH M3(R2), the nonclinical safety package supporting a Phase II trial of up to 30 days in women of childbearing potential comprises:
- 1-month repeat-dose toxicity in rodent (ICH M3(R2) Table 1) — supports clinical trial duration up to 30 days.
- 1-month repeat-dose toxicity in non-rodent (ICH M3(R2) Table 1) — supports clinical trial duration up to 30 days.
- Ames bacterial reverse mutation assay (ICH S2(R1)) — standard genotoxicity battery — required for first-in-human.
- in vitro mammalian cell genotoxicity assay (ICH S2(R1)) — standard genotoxicity battery — required for first-in-human.
- in vivo genotoxicity assay (micronucleus or comet) (ICH S2(R1)) — required for repeat-dose clinical trials beyond 2 weeks.
- cardiovascular safety pharmacology (ICH S7A) — core safety pharmacology battery for first-in-human.
- central nervous system safety pharmacology (ICH S7A) — core safety pharmacology battery for first-in-human.
- respiratory safety pharmacology (ICH S7A) — core safety pharmacology battery for first-in-human.
- in vitro hERG channel assay (ICH S7B) — cardiac repolarization risk assessment for first-in-human.
- embryo-fetal development study (one species) (ICH S5(R3)) — women of childbearing potential enrollment.
- embryo-fetal development study (second species) (ICH S5(R3)) — confirmatory species for WOCBP enrollment beyond Phase I.
- fertility and early embryonic development study (ICH S5(R3)) — required prior to Phase III for WOCBP.
